So canonical_conjugate cannot canonicalise the KNOWN-GOOD BvLS orbit matrix. Two possibilities, both disqualifying until resolved: (a) the canonicalisation/greedy relabelling is buggy and does not reach lex-min, or (b) the symmetry break as encoded EXCLUDES a solution that provably exists (the second makes the break UNSOUND and any INFEASIBLE worthless). The detached run orbit_z3_enc_g99_symbreak_detached.captured.txt was launched with symbreak=True on this unvalidated break and has been QUARANTINED (annotated NOT EVIDENCE — SYMMETRY BREAK UNVALIDATED at top; no verdict from it may be reported or filed while the m=81 acceptance fails). Fix and re-run the acceptance test: the break is admissible ONLY when the known-good BvLS m=81 matrix survives canonicalisation AND the model then ACCEPTS it, exactly as the unbroken encoding did in 3.30s (task orbit-matrix-fixed-acceptance-test).
